expire: UPDATE bookings SET status='expired' WHERE event=? AND status='held' AND expires<=?
promote: UPDATE bookings SET status='held', expires=? WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM bookings WHERE event=? AND status='waiting' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id=? AND status='open' AND starts>?) ORDER BY created,id LIMIT MAX(0,(SELECT capacity FROM events WHERE id=?)-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE event=? AND (status='confirmed' OR (status='held' AND expires>?)))))
reserve: INSERT INTO bookings(id,event,user,name,email,status,expires,created) SELECT ?,id,?,?,?,'held',?,? FROM events WHERE id=? AND status='open' AND starts>? AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE event=events.id AND (status='confirmed' OR (status='held' AND expires>?)))<capacity AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bookings WHERE event=events.id AND status='waiting') ON CONFLICT(event,user) DO UPDATE SET status='held',expires=excluded.expires,created=excluded.created,checked=0 WHERE bookings.status IN ('cancelled','expired')
wait: INSERT INTO bookings(id,event,user,name,email,status,expires,created) SELECT ?,id,?,?,?,'waiting',0,? FROM events WHERE id=? AND status='open' AND starts>? AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE event=events.id AND (status='confirmed' OR (status='held' AND expires>?)))>=capacity OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bookings WHERE event=events.id AND status='waiting')) ON CONFLICT(event,user) DO UPDATE SET status='waiting',expires=0,created=excluded.created,checked=0 WHERE bookings.status IN ('cancelled','expired')
confirm: UPDATE bookings SET status='confirmed',expires=0 WHERE event=? AND user=? AND status='held' AND expires>? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id=? AND status='open' AND starts>?)
